entries.name: On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Magic)

system.description:
Radiant offensive magic that leaves traces of shining light on its target. On hit, 50% chance to inflict the target with 'Shine' status effect. This grants Advantage on the next single attack roll against that unit. If the target already has Shine, change to 100% chance on hit.

Gain 10 additional uses of this spell at B rank proficiency in Divine magic.

Heal yourself or an adjacent allied unit by 2d6 + Cha HP and 1d4 Stn. 

 Uses: 5 per Divine Proficiency rank

Grant the "Blessed" status to all adjacent friendly units. Lasts for 4 turns. While Blessed, units receive a 1d4 bonus to all attack rolls, skill checks and saving throws. 


 Uses: 1 per Divine Proficiency rank
